About a decade back, my twoprov partner couldn’t make it to a gig, so I very quickly became a solo improviser without meaning to and I’ve been doing it ever since. I also improvise plays with Somewhat Theatre and Magnetic North. I directed the show Heads Might Roll and haven’t taught much.
